title: crypto2dev: AES-CTR and AES-XTS callbacks
description: Extend the cipher callbacks to cover AES-CTR and AES-XTS, both of which crypto2dev supports. AES-CTR: map WC_CIPHER_AES_CTR → algo string 'ctr(aes)', no padding (stream cipher), IV is 16-byte counter block from aes->reg. AES-XTS: map WC_CIPHER_AES_XTS → algo string 'xts(aes)', requires 32-byte (AES-128-XTS) or 64-byte (AES-256-XTS) key (two AES keys concatenated), tweak value plays the role of IV. Follow same fd pool acquire/SET_IV/write/FINALIZE/read/release pattern as AES-CBC. AES-CTR one-shot and streaming both valid. AES-XTS is block-device sector-granular — no streaming, always one-shot per sector.
notes: AES-CTR is used in TLS 1.2 AES-CTR cipher suites and some disk encryption schemes. AES-XTS is the standard for disk encryption (dm-crypt, FileVault, BitLocker). Both are in crypto2dev because wolfcrypt.ko registers them. wolfSSL CryptoCb wrappers: wc_CryptoCb_AesCtr() and wc_CryptoCb_AesXts().
